title: Ingredients become the signature

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is a poster frame

slide_intent: Connect the mark with the product through transformation so viewers understand the food idea embedded in its form.
strategic_value: An ingredient assembly that resolves into the logo can strengthen Burger King’s food-shaped recognition.
demonstration: Wavy horizontal color bands become floating illustrated ingredients, assemble into a burger, then resolve into the primary signature.
practical_value: Study a transition whose final symbol retains the shape and color logic of the preceding food.

content_islands.name: Color bands
content_islands.spec: Begin with full-frame undulating food-colored layers.

content_islands.name: Ingredient assembly
content_islands.spec: Separate and rotate the illustrated components before stacking them around the emerging lettering.

content_islands.name: Logo resolution
content_islands.spec: Remove ingredient detail to leave the orange-bun and red-letter signature on cream.

reference_purposes.Expression: The sequence visibly transforms ingredient layers into the primary logo.

ingredient.name: Ingredient-to-logo transformation
ingredient.role: Link brand recognition directly to the food.
ingredient.application: Observe the sequence from color layers to floating ingredients to a simplified signature.
ingredient.scope: Complete JKR demonstration clip; no timing or easing requirements are stated.
